jobs.title: Software Engineer AI Coding Tasks
jobs.description:
We're looking for experienced software engineers to build AI coding tasks from a codebase they know well. US$1,000 per task, and you can do as many tasks as you want.

You turn a real change from a repository you know into a task that today's best AI coding models struggle with: hard for the models, but fair for a skilled engineer. Your tasks are used to measure and train AI coding models.

Remote, any location. US$1,000 per task that passes review. Minimum of one task a week, about 10 hours a week.


How it works

  1. Apply. Complete a short screener interview and upload your resume.
  2. Propose. Once you're selected, pick a change from a repository you know and submit a short proposal. We approve it or suggest a better candidate.
  3. Build. In our platform, set up the repository as it was before the change, then write the brief, the correct solution and the grading checks.
  4. Stress-test. Try lazy, incorrect and shortcut solutions and make sure your checks catch them.
  5. Model testing. Run your task against leading AI models until strong models often fail but a skilled engineer can clearly solve it.
  6. Review. A reviewer checks your task and you revise it. Most tasks take more than one round.
  7. Next task. Once your task is accepted, start another.


Requirements

  • 2+ years of professional software engineering
  • Code merged into a public open-source repository, ideally one you know well. A private codebase you own may also qualify (not employer or client code)
  • Strong in at least one of Python, TypeScript, Go, Rust, Java or C++
  • Solid with Docker, Linux, Git and automated testing
  • Regular use of an AI coding tool
  • Experience writing tests, rubrics or evaluation criteria, ideally for AI models
  • You can explain a change clearly and concisely, in your own words
  • At least 10 hours a week, starting now
  • A secure personal or work computer (no public or shared machines)


Nice to have

  • Deep expertise in one area, such as databases, compilers, distributed systems, security or infrastructure
  • Experience building agent tasks or RL environments


Terms

  • US$1,000 for each task that passes our quality review, paid directly to you
  • Once your proposal is qualified, you sign Askable's contract and accept its terms
  • The work is used for AI training. The change and your solution must be your own, and you must be free to license them to us
  • Don't publish the work anywhere: no public pull request or public fork


Apply at https://www.askable.com/experts/roles/senior-software-engineer

jobs.description:
About Us:

Wrapbook is the AI platform for production finance. Weâre building a system of action that puts finance teams in control of their whole production, from payroll, to spend, to accounting.

Built for feature films, TV, and commercials, Wrapbook is trusted by teams at Netflix, Paramount, Anonymous Content, and more. With backing from Andreessen Horowitz, Bessemer Venture Partners, and Jeffrey Katzenberg's WndrCo, our team of 350+ is using AI to transform how finance teams work and empower them to do more with less.

The Opportunity: Senior Software Engineer II, Applied AI (Remote - USA / Canada)

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer II, Applied AI to join our Agentic Systems team, where you'll build AI agents that automate workflows for teams across Wrapbook. You'll partner directly with internal teams like Marketing, Sales, Support, Operations and Finance to find high-leverage processes, then design, ship and iterate on agents that take real work off their plates. This is a chance to define how a 400+ person company runs on AI. You'll see the impact of your work every day, while shaping the patterns, tools and standards for how we build agents at Wrapbook.

What Youâll Do:

  • Design and build production-grade AI agents with LangGraph that automate multi-step workflows for internal teams across Wrapbook

  • Deploy, run and scale agents on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, using its runtime, memory, identity and gateway capabilities to make them secure and reliable, while tracking what they cost to run and keeping it efficient as usage grows

  • Partner with internal teams to find high-impact workflows, draw out requirements from people who can't hand you a spec, and turn them into agent-driven solutions, explaining clearly what each agent can and can't reliably do

  • Integrate agents with Wrapbook's internal systems, APIs and third-party tools so they can take real actions, not just answer questions

  • Build evaluation, observability and guardrail frameworks to measure agent quality, catch failures and keep humans in the loop where it matters

  • Establish reusable patterns, shared tools and best practices that let the Agentic Systems team ship new agents quickly and consistently

  • Own agents end to end, from prototype to production, measuring their impact on the teams they serve and iterating based on usage data and feedback

  • Drive adoption through clear documentation, training and enablement, so teams understand what each agent does, trust it and know how to get the most from it

What Youâll Have:

  • 6+ years of back-end development experience with Python, TypeScript/Node.js or Java, with a track record of delivering systems built for security, scalability, availability and performance

  • Hands-on experience building and shipping LLM-powered agents or workflows (with models such as Claude, GPT, Llama or Mistral), including prompting, tool use and structured outputs. You can walk us through one you built: how it was designed, what broke and how you fixed it

  • Production experience with at least one agent or LLM framework, such as LangGraph, LangChain, LlamaIndex or AutoGen, and a solid understanding of AI architectures like RAG, reranking and multi-agent orchestration. Experience with LangGraph specifically is a plus

  • A security-first mindset: you think about data access, permissions and failure modes in everything you build, especially when agents can take real actions

  • Strong product sense and communication skills, with the ability to work directly with non-technical teams to understand their workflows and turn them into reliable automation

  • Comfort with ambiguity and an ownership mentality: you can take a loosely defined problem from idea to production on your own

  • Nice to have: experience running AWS workloads in production and knowing how to design for, deploy on and get the most out of Amazon's services, ideally including Amazon Bedrock AgentCore

Why Join Us:

At Wrapbook, creativity meets technology â and not just in the product.

In addition to a competitive salary and all the benefits you can expect from a fast-growing technology company, youâll get access to a team of creative problem solvers and the chance to see your contributions make large impacts Benefits include:

Wrapbook pledges to be a harassment- and discrimination-free space for everyone, regardless of age, disability, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, nationality, neurotype, personal appearance, political affiliation, professional background, race, religion, or sexual identity or orientation.

jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Your Opportunity

As a Principal Engineer, you will help design, build, and operate the clinical decision support and API-driven data delivery platform that enables Vytalize Health to embed timely, actionable clinical insights directly into provider workflows. Working cross-functionally with Data Engineering, Product, Clinical Operations, and EMR partners, your solutions will transform how clinicians access dataâmoving from external tools and workarounds to seamless, in-workflow decision support via CDS Hooks and real-time APIs.

You will own the technical foundation for Clinical Decision Support (CDS) Hooks, REST APIs, and the architectural patterns that ensure clinical data is accessible, trustworthy, and performant at the moment of care. This role sits at the intersection of healthcare interoperability standards, modern API design, and operational excellence. You will establish reliability metrics and SLAs that ensure CDS Hooks and APIs serve clinician workflows with consistent quality and performance. You will be part of a small, high-performing healthcare engineering team where engineers support each other's growth through mentorship and tight collaboration.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Lead design and implementation of the CDS Hooks platform, including card orchestration, hook context handling, EHR-side logic orchestration, and integration with downstream data services

  • Own CDS Hook API contracts and evolution, ensuring compliance with SMART CDS Hooks specification while adding performance, reliability, and healthcare-specific optimizations

  • Lead technical integration with EMR systems (Epic, NextGen, Athena, ECW) for CDS Hook discovery, execution, card rendering, and user action handling

  • Design, build, and maintain public-facing REST and event-driven APIs exposing clinical data, quality metrics, care gaps, attribution data, and decision support content to partners and provider-facing applications

  • Establish API contracts, versioning strategies, and deprecation policies that balance innovation with stability for external consumers

  • Implement and maintain API security patterns including OAuth 2.0, scope-based authorization, rate limiting, and audit logging for compliant clinical data access

  • Design and optimize real-time or near-real-time data pipelines feeding CDS Hooks and APIsâensuring low latency, high freshness, and graceful failure modes

  • Design and implement comprehensive testing and QA frameworks for CDS Hooks and APIs â including hook context validation, card rendering verification, and clinical workflow testing across EMR systems

  • Establish reliability metrics and SLAs (latency, availability, freshness) for CDS Hook delivery and API performance; measure and track against clinical requirements

  • Define and measure clinical impact metrics â adoption of CDS Hooks, clinician interaction rates, workflow integration success, and patient outcome influence

  • Exercise architectural judgment across tradeoffs in correctness, latency, scalability, maintainability, and operational risk in clinical data systems

  • Design and implement reliability patterns for CDS and API services including monitoring, alerting, failure detection, graceful degradation, and incident recovery

  • Partner with Data Reliability Engineer to define and operate SLAs for CDS Hook delivery, API response times, and data freshness aligned to clinical needs

  • Establish and uphold engineering standards for API design, data schemas, integration patterns, and interoperability; maintain high-quality technical documentation and OpenAPI specifications

  • Partner with Data Engineering to align upstream data models, gold-layer datasets, and platform capabilities with clinical decision support and API requirements

  • Serve as the technical authority on clinical interoperability standards (SMART CDS Hooks, FHIR, HL7, CDS Hooks, EHR integration patterns)

  • Collaborate with Product, Clinical Operations, and Business stakeholders to clarify requirements, translate clinical workflows into platform features, and shape product direction

  • Act as trusted technical advisor to EMR partners, healthcare systems, and external API consumers; ensure expectations and delivery are well-defined and predictable

  • Ensure all CDS and API services comply with healthcare security, privacy, and regulatory requirements (HIPAA, state regulations, payer mandates)

  • Partner with IT Security and Compliance teams to implement secure access controls, audit logging, encryption, and data protection measures across delivery mechanisms

  • Design and implement audit trails for all clinical data access; support compliance audits and regulatory reporting

  • Mentor team members through design reviews, pairing, and architectural guidance on clinical data integration and API design

  • Document new and existing systems, designs, processes, and procedures

Required Qualifications

  • 8+ years of experience designing, building, and operating API platforms, service-oriented systems, or backend infrastructure at scale

  • Demonstrated experience operating at a senior or staff-level individual contributor scope, owning complex systems end-to-end

  • 3+ years of direct experience with healthcare data integrations, EMR workflows, clinical data exchange, or healthcare interoperability standards (FHIR, HL7, CDA, claims data)

  • 2+ years of hands-on experience with CDS Hooks, SMART on FHIR, or similar clinical decision support APIs

  • Strong experience designing and operating REST APIs, including contract design, versioning, error handling, and authentication/authorization patterns

  • Deep understanding of healthcare data integrations, EMR workflows, and interoperability patterns (FHIR, HL7, CDS Hooks, SMART on FHIR)

  • Expertise in designing for reliability, SLAs, and operational metrics; ability to translate clinical requirements into technical SLOs

  • Experience defining and measuring API performance metrics (latency, availability, error rates); familiarity with SLA monitoring and enforcement

  • Strong systems thinking with ability to design for scale, reliability, maintainability, and resilience

  • Proficiency in modern backend languages (Python, Java, Go, or similar); comfort reading and reviewing code across languages

  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Databricks, GCP) and containerized services (Docker, Kubernetes, or managed services)

  • Proven ability to partner effectively across engineering, product, analytics, clinical operations, and business teams

  • Clear written and verbal communication skills, particularly for explaining technical concepts and tradeoffs to clinicians and non-specialists

  • Comfortable working in a fast-moving, ambiguous environment with healthcare compliance and regulatory constraints

Strong Pluses

  • Hands-on experience with CDS Hooks specification and SMART on FHIR implementations in production healthcare environments

  • Experience implementing and testing CDS Hooks across multiple EMR systems (Epic, NextGen, Athena, ECW) including clinical workflow validation

  • Familiarity with healthcare data formats and standards: FHIR resources (Patient, Condition, Medication, etc.), CCD/C-CDA, claims data (837s, 835s), HL7 v2 or v3

  • Experience designing and operating real-time or near-real-time data pipelines feeding clinical applications and decision support systems

  • Knowledge of value-based care metrics, care gaps, quality measures (NQF, HEDIS), and HCC/RAF risk stratification

  • Experience with API management platforms, developer portals, or partner ecosystem / API monetization patterns

  • Familiarity with OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SAML, and federated identity patterns in healthcare systems

  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure-as-code, and safe deployment practices

  • Background supporting provider-facing platforms or external clinical partners; deep understanding of provider workflows and constraints

  • Experience in a healthcare startup or high-growth healthcare technology environment

  • Familiarity with healthcare data governance, interoperability regulations (21st Century Cures, ONC rules), and clinical data quality frameworks

  • Experience with API testing frameworks and quality assurance for distributed systems

Perks/Benefits

  • Competitive base compensation

  • Annual bonus potential

  • Health benefits effective on start date

  • Health & Wellness Program; up to $300 per quarter for your overall well-being available on start date

  • 401K plan effective on the first of the month after your start date; 100% of up to 4% of your annual salary

  • Unlimited (or generous) paid "Vytal Time", and 5 paid sick days after your first 90 days

  • Company paid STD/LTD

  • Technology setup

  • Ability to help build a market leader in value-based healthcare at a rapidly growing organization

Please note at no time during our screening, interview, or selection process do we ask for additional personal information (beyond your resume) or account/financial information. We will also never ask for you to purchase anything; nor will we ever interview you via text message. Any communication received from a Vytalize Health recruiter during your screening, interviewing, or selection process will come from an email ending in @vytalizehealth.com
